notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.14
notes.content:
This update was done during the weekend, but we decided to delay this announcement for a few days while we finished the new achievements images. Check them at the end or in your library ;)


Here is the full list

Version 1.0.14


[h2][b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]

- Fixed a hidden path that could cause a softlock in the clear water crater map.
- Fixed quest and reward notification triggers, where in some quests the rewards window would only open after opening another menu or chatting with an NPC.


[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]

- Fixed a void in fractured sands you could walk on.
- Fixed some ruby pillars that could not be mined 
- Fool's hat and other battle recovery items no longer revive downed porbles
- Prevented fusion error messages from when trying to update lower majesty augmentation slots.
- Preventing fusion from evolving porbles unless the stones are manually placed (this to avoid unwanted evolutions when adding all augments)


[h2][b]OPTMIZATION[/b][/h2]

- Fixed a statue animation triggering too early in Fractured Sands.
- Added helper text to Majesty 3 altars stating which Biome is getting filtered to make it easier to understand what altar works for which porbles.
- Updating gear effect icons
- Fixing status effect icon alignment
- Preventing lootable items from not displaying the tooltip message of what you are missing if you have already attempted it once.


[Spoiler] 74IN1T87 [/spoiler]
[h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2]

- Initiated a better way of displaying status effects. For now, most will be generic status effect icons with tooltips. Soon we will release a version that also works for controllers and is more complete.
- Many achievement images have been replaced with newer versions, so all the achievements are more unique. (You can see them all here https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2464460/achievements)




[hr][/hr]

Thanks for the support, and we will carry on trying to make Portal Fantasy the best game we can make.
Found something weird in the game? Please report it in the Steam discussion group, and we will try and sort it as fast as possible.

notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.12 & 1.0.13
notes.content:
Between bank holidays, a couple of Spring colds in the team, this update took a bit longer. 

But it is a meaty one. In fact, so meaty that we ended up fusing 2 releases in one. 


Version 1.0.12 / 1.0.13


[h2][b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Fixed some situations where crafted shovels would not work as planned
- Issue fixed with the dragon cave where players could get stuck in a loop.
- Majesty 2 and Majesty 3 Steam achievements should trigger now if they didn't work for you in the past (if you start the game, they will appear)


[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Fable chest can no longer give recipes for majesty stones, but will give majesty stones instead
- Fixed merchant in Under City, where, in some cases, purchases were not possible
- Fixed issue with recipe access in Springbloom
- Fixed a scenario where, after Silent Woods, Rudder conversation would not trigger the next quests immediately. 
- Fixed Animkiig NPC animation not playing
- Fixed the hermit quest gate not opening after the end of the quest at Clear Water Crater, unless the game was restarted for some players
- Added extra support for NPC appear effect, which should remove the possibility of NPCS not spawning when they should.
- Fix for Dread Form and Eldritch Nightmate battle icons
- Majesty stones made Tier 3 treasure drop rather than Tier 4


[h2][b]OPTMIZATION[/b][/h2]
- Improved some colliders in several maps to allow better passage and more fluid movement
- Improved Springbloom puzzle system since there was a chance players could lock themselves out after a specific set of actions.
- The End Game message has been rewritten to avoid confusion
- Updating default icon for gear effects
- Official controller input icons for Steam Deck
- Adding placeholders for status in-battle status effects + tooltips (working on the final ones as fast as possible, but wanted to give you guys something there already)
- Added some improvements that should support more controller models (do let us know in the Steam forums if this affects you still)


[h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2]
- The Portal maps now highlight when you unlock a new map inside a biome
- Redeem codes have been removed from the main menu, to avoid a situation where players would redeem the codes before starting a new game, and items would be lost (and caused some issues with players with keyboards? )

[spoiler]QG78VWCM[/spoiler]


There are some issues we are still investigating and solving as soon as possible

- In the Steam Deck, due to the increase of font in some areas the font overflows
- Reports of lag in some battles
- Player reports of battles freezing after a certain point (we are investigating what item , skill, porble is causing it)

If you have anything else we haven't spotted, please reach out to us in the Steam forum or just add Haron as friend (they live in Steam now) 
https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199527335829/

[hr][/hr]

Thanks for the support, and we will carry on trying to make Portal Fantasy the best game we can make.
Found something weird in the game? Please report it in the Steam discussion group, and we will try and sort it as fast as possible.

notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.6
notes.content:
With this update, we had to make a hard decision. 
Our colouring system was causing some issues in some porbles and causing errors when players tried to evolve them.
We are working on fixing it, but it will take some days to have them all working as intended. So we opted for a bit more dramatic move. You should be able to evolve all porbles that can be evolved to Majesty 3 fine. But in the cases where the dyes would cause a problem, the dyes will be removed.
To make up for this, a [b]COMPENSATION CODE TO BE RELEASED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS[/b] which will include enough dyes to set your porbles back to being the living canvas you always wanted.

We are also aware of some areas that are causing some issues with quest progress, and we are fixing them (many already are in test stage) and will be pushed as soon as possible, hopefully tomorrow 

Here is the full list of this update log

Version 1.0.6



[h2][b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Fixed an error when evolving to Majesty 3 with dyed porbles for some species that was causing errors and not allowing the evolutions. In those cases, the Porble will evolve but lose custom colours. [b](COMPENSATION CODE TO BE RELEASED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS)[/b]


[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Prevention of the Fusion UI from allowing you to place 1st level majesty stones when doing more advanced majesty evolutions in some altars.
- Some baddie battles with broken Porbles (black boxes) were fixed
- Image fixes in some porbles



[h2][b]OPTMIZATION[/b][/h2]
- Moving platforms now pause when players open menus, avoiding void falls
- Cleaning of some dialogues (minor typos)

[h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2]
- Carry on work with the antivirus companies to fully whitelist all files in the game to prevent false risk warnings


[hr][/hr]

Thanks for the support, and we will carry on trying to make Portal Fantasy the best game we can make.
Found something weird in the game? Please report it in the Steam discussion group, and we will try and sort it as fast as possible.

notes.title: Bugfixes version 1.0.4 & 1.0.5
notes.content:
2 updates back to back today

The main highlights are a major fix that should help players with Steam Deck models that had problems starting the game.
The other is the addition of the possibility of enabling v-synch if desired under the settings.
By default, it will be off as it has been to this point, but if you want, you can enable it (this will cause the game to close and has to be restarted). We will add a confirmation message in a later version, but we wanted to enable this option for all of you as fast as possible.



Here is the full list

Version 1.0.4 & 1.0.5


[h2][b]MAJOR BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- Improvements for the launcher to solve issues that, in some machines (mainly some Steam Deck models), were preventing the game from starting.


[h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2]
- The quest "Prove Yourself" should now trigger properly and open the gate
- Fixed a small issue where, under very specific conditions, a 100% chance scroll would fail


[h2][b]OPTMIZATION[/b][/h2]
- The letter in the intro flashback was moved to make it more obvious for the quest
- Discord button removed from the gameplay to not cover anything


[h2][b]QOL[/b][/h2]
- New V-Synch option in settings. By default, it is off (as it was before), but now players can enable it if so desired. 


Probably no updates tomorrow, Easter Sunday, as the team does need a break to recharge from the last few days and to spend time with family and friends. Good old Haron will still be around, but the replies might take a bit longer than usual.
Monday, it will be back to business

[hr][/hr]

Thanks for the support, and we will carry on trying to make Portal Fantasy the best game we can make.
Found something weird in the game? Please report it in the Steam discussion group, and we will try and sort it as fast as possible.

notes.title: We are LIVE! Welcome to Portal Fantasy
notes.content:
First of all, apologies for those that were there on the planned hour. The team found a minor issue and we decided to fix it before the launch.

But the wait is over Wanderer and the Portals are open – Portal Fantasy is Now Live!

After years of work, months of feedback, and way too many porble puns, Portal Fantasy is officially launched! 🎉

Dive into the pixel-packed Kingdom of Pyli and begin your journey today — full of creatures to capture, puzzles to solve, secrets to uncover, and a vibrant cast of characters that are weird in a loveable way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/91153794a5792892ef1672361354d054cbb50128.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]PROMOS [/b][/h1]
And as mentioned before, there is the bonus of not only the 10% discount at launch but we got our buddies from Coromon with us via the Coromon x Portal Fantasy Bundle!
With their current promotion until the 25th of April, you can grab Coromon for almost free when you purchase the Portal Fantasy + Coromon Bundle on Steam.

It's a perfect pairing for monster-taming fans, so if you haven’t checked Coromon out yet — now’s your chance!

If you already own Coromon, you can still take advantage of the 15% off by completing the bundle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/6a5d378b1b6378c9d0aa99e956f019343dd50f6f.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Twitch Drops Are Live![/b][/h1]

We’ve also activated Twitch Drops until the 7th of May! If you watch any streamer playing Portal Fantasy with drops enabled, you can unlock exclusive in-game rewards:

notes.title: Roadmap, Pricing, & Coromon x Portal Fantasy!
notes.content:
Hello Portal Wanderers!

We are super excited for the launch next week. But before launch day arrives on the 16th, we’ve got some special info to share that will give you a glimpse into what lies beyond...


 [h1][b]The Portal Fantasy Roadmap[/b][/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/a0acccd335f8d37495518ccb2c4682c29060590d.jpg[/img]

These are our current plans for the journey ahead, from everything you’ll find right from the launch day to what’s coming in future updates. We don't want to provide just a static game but an adventure that keeps expanding with more stories, quests, and Porbles for you to discover.


Here’s a quick review of what we have planned:

[h3]Launch[/h3]
From day one, you’ll be able to dive into the rich world of Pyli Kingdom — meeting quirky NPCs, solving ancient puzzles, collecting and battling with your Porbles, and uncovering the darker corners of the realm. Enjoy this full-fledged adventure with your porbles, gear, and familiars. 

[h3]Stage 1 – Post-Launch Updates (Versions 1.x)[/h3]
We’ll be rolling out regular content updates labeled as v1.x, each bringing new features, areas, quests, and quality-of-life improvements. Think of this as expanding the foundation — more fun, more Porbles, and more world to explore.
With the shift to the game being offline, we had to push PvP for a bit later, but it will still be here. You now just have more time to perfect your team of porbles before facing other trainers

[h3]Stage 2 – Major Content Drop (Version 2.0)[/h3]
Then comes the big one. Version 2.0 will introduce entirely new areas to the game — The Outer Realms - mysterious news regions with brand new biomes full of fresh challenges, lore, and plenty of secrets. It’s the next chapter in your journey, and we can’t wait to reveal more when the time is right.

Everything you see here is already in motion, and we’ll continue to listen to your feedback as we build. We want Portal Fantasy to be a living, growing world for you to enjoy together with your Porbles.


[h1]Pricing[/h1]

Ok, now that we managed to earworm ourselves with Jessie J's song, let's talk about the game price. Some of you have asked about this, so it is time to announce it.

We are launching at $19.99, and we will have a 10% discount for the first 7 days. 
But we are also aware that not every country has the same spending power, so we carefully checked every country, and regional pricing may differ depending on where you are (always lower, never higher). 

But it's not a party if you don't bring a friend along, right? 



[h1]Coromon x Portal Fantasy[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/6a5d378b1b6378c9d0aa99e956f019343dd50f6f.jpg[/img]

Coromon is joining us at our launch! You can acquire 2 pixel art creature-capture games for 15% off. And if you already have Coromon in your Library (I know I do), you can still receive the discount for Portal Fantasy by completing the bundle. 


We're counting down the days with you. See you on April 16th.


[hr]  [/hr]

notes.title: Portal Fantasy is Launching April 16th!
notes.content:
Greetings,  Portal Wanderers!

We have some important news to share regarding the launch of Portal Fantasy. After much consideration and in response to the awesome feedback from you guys and seeing many of the streamers who have showcased our game, we've decided to reschedule our launch date from April 3rd to April 16th.

[h2][b ]Why the Delay? [/b][/h2]

As gamers ourselves, one of our main goals has always been to make sure we are giving you the best gaming experience we can. Over the past year, your feedback has been crucial in highlighting what needed improvement. To ensure that every player, regardless of location, enjoys the best journey possible in the Kingdom of Pyli, we've decided to implement a significant enhancement: offline.

[h3]Transition to Offline Mode[/h3]
By shifting Portal Fantasy to an offline experience, we want to provide a consistent gameplay experience without the dependency on server and internet connectivity. This change ensures that all players can embark on their adventures without interruption and that you can play Portal Fantasy anywhere (looking at you, Steam Deck users). This should also improve load times due to the previous server dependency.

This will cause a delay in releasing PvP, so it won't be available straight at launch as that has to be online, and we need to make sure all works as intended. PvP is still on the roadmap coming soon!

These 2 others are some big improvements we've been keeping a secret, but we can give you a sneak peek, since we are delaying the launch.

[h3]Enhanced NPC Portraits [/h3]
Our beloved characters now come to life with richer, more detailed portraits, adding depth and personality to your interactions with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/d8a7d36aecf0896a52e87bd2b053f3ebe0f65589.jpg[/img]
[i]Doesn't Jeejee look much more expressive? And she is not the only one. Wait until you finally see Dar's face.[/i]


[h3]Improved Porble Growth Stats Display[/h3]
We've revamped the way Porble growth statistics are presented, offering clearer insights into your creatures' development and strengths as they level up and evolve.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/43bdccad0ff64d1e4f6912d5fb0bfe130d6caa75.jpg[/img]
[i]He might have a shy personality, but look at those shiny stats[/i]


[h2]Why Not Update Post-Launch?[/h2]

While we could have proceeded with the original launch date and introduced these and other improvements in subsequent updates, we know that you deserve the best experience from day one. Taking this additional time allows us to integrate these improvements and test them properly, making sure you get the best experience for the adventure that awaits you at launch and not a few days later.

We know that delays can be annoying and frustrating, and we sincerely believe this is the best choice. Your patience and support mean the world to us, and we're committed to making Portal Fantasy worth the wait, instead of rushing the launch. 

We can't wait for you to experience the world of Pyli on April 16th!

notes.title: I have a dream....of pigeons?
notes.content:
[h2]Pigeon Island[/h2]

We have heard you. Those pigeons in the town square? They are so much fun to run to them and make them fly. A childhood pleasure for many.
But what if we could make it bigger? 
Like a whole island of it. Well just speak to Granny and she will send you to Pigeon Island.  Where our dreams will be made real


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/4a97a8dba1f802e62ef43d5b956dbb046455fb41.gif[/img]

There is only one problem. Our island is kinda...empty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/0ae4c509d4dc8e8ab87c89bdc38cf5737bf1a08d.gif[/img]

But that is where you can come and help us.
We are using a mix of magic and technology and turning each one of your follows on our [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@portalfantasyio]TikTok[/url] into a pigeon.
Yes, magic.  Not adding them manually...no. That would be insane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/6cf418ca39ee41d20fcff3b2d2e797746b4b0046.gif[/img]

[h2]Cool Guy[/h2]

With Pigeon Island a new NPC showed up in town as well. He is the [b]Cool Guy[/b]. And he will say anything you tell him to say. Because he is just here for the cool vibes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/9950edf7a8e927944a7ffdd800e55c48cb861b21.jpg[/img]

You can find them next to the notice board (You know the one that informs you of the berry thief)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/fa74f6e770641c8366c0447e3be4b899dfc0b09b.jpg[/img]

The way it works is every few days we will post the new sentence on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@portalfantasyio]Tiktok[/url] and the most-liked comment on that post will be part of the game for a few days. 
And yes we have had some high-quality comments.... never mind

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/e692f417b33663083aec2d266dc597568556f1a8.jpg[/img]


[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

So if you want to try and break the game and our sanity by adding too many pigeons follow us on [b]tiktok[/b] [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@portalfantasyio] https://www.tiktok.com/@portalfantasyio[/url]. And look up the latest post about the cool guy to try and get them to say your sentence of choice.

2 opportunities to literally be part of the game and make it more chaotic than usual.

notes.title: Demo update Version 0.003 - I do speak Português, I can speak Ingles
notes.content:
You told us you didn’t like the font and we listened. Our new custom-made non-pixelated font is now available for your eyeball comfort.

For comparison, this is the old font:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/772e52af13068dfaef488eaee8bb14c4a91c5de3.jpg[/img]

And this is the new one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/970b97bc77cd2a40754c303112fedd762f11fb4b.jpg[/img]

Much easier to read, don’t you think? What was that? English is not your language? Worry not, we've got you covered. We have 2 new fully supported fonts for
[list]
[*]Portuguese (PT-BR)
[*]Spanish (ES)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/42807402f6fc66578aedd8c9cd7519cef22ddaef.gif[/img]


The game also has the option for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean but those are still in the works and are not optimized, so you might find them hard to read or out of place (or even just not working) in some places.

Talking of optimizing, we carry on improving the game's performance. We have upgraded the game engine, so you will see that the game is much smoother when you move and does not stutter like it did in some of the busier map areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/4ba584990bd07cbcdf927854961eb23824130221.gif[/img]

And since you can move so well, now you can hunt for more items all over the map. We have reduced the size of items that are in boxes, chests, bushes… well, basically everywhere. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/dac189c07baa1d66e99eb0b0505c08f0ebed4fb2.png[/img]

Thanks, [url=https://www.youtube.com/@IamDylanB]Dylan[/url] for this great meme and you should check out his energetic [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLsqPvKCWgSqXXgDXtE1NP25vhoJnq6y1X]playthrough of our demo[/url]. 

This adds a bit more realistic perspective as it made no sense for berries to be as big as you. Also, stop stealing all the berries. The berry farmer is after you.


Another thing you all asked for was to understand better what kind of damage was being done in the battles. And it makes sense if we are building a strategic battle system. So now the damage is colour-coded, and has a written label identifying what kind it is and its source. Prettier and efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/7eb23225161ffd76fdcc8e07594c093f652f719f.png[/img]

Our desert now has 2 new types of traps
[list]
[*]Sawblades 
[*] Quicksand (an area where you can’t jump)
[/list]
Give them a try and let us know what you think

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/ba5bf484a332aedc19d84596bd869d136b8e65ea.png[/img]

That’s it for now. There were some bugs that you reported which also got fixed, but if you find any more please let us know in our community hub as we want to build this game with you.

We are continuously working on the game and hope to bring you full support for Chinese, Japanese and Korean very soon, as well as the so-desired PVP.

Keep an eye on our socials, as we will be giving some sneak peeks into the dungeons and evolution.

notes.title: Demo update Version 0.002 - Auto login, new desert, and Groobeet breakdancing
notes.content:
Oh man, so many new cool things. Ok, ok, let us focus here.

[h3]Auto login[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/cfa3165cc91328953bbfea75b395afc9640d2768.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/73b3aae325c8e275c688326c6b3afb397f756112.png[/img][/url]

First things first. Full Steam auto-login. No more messy inserting emails or logging in using your gamer fingers. Those will be reserved for your journey through the world of Portal Fantasy. 
If this is your first time in the demo, you will see a screen asking you to choose your game name (the name that the other players will see you as in the world).



[h3]Valeria[/h3]

Thanks to all the feedback from you guys and the lovely content creators who have been streaming us, we have made several 'quality of life' improvements. Some examples are:
[list]
[*] Pointing out the healing fountain after the tutorial battle (we know many missed it)
[*] Jeejee now moves to point out which door you can go through to choose your first porble.
[*] Teakka quest has been expanded so it is clearer where you can find them.
[*] Now when you start typing to chat with the other players, a speech bubble appears above your head.
[/list]

And the best improvement of all... Groobeet now breakdances. What do you mean you never saw a turtle-like creature breakdancing? Well go and check them out for yourself then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/55ec5176ca0ce3e3e9e84c93979edba65a6f5404.gif[/img]

[h3]Desert[/h3]

The whole map layout was improved. New look, new critters (you can find some scorpions and lizards moving around), and more spikes. Because everyone needs more spikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/003386ba338bd603cb0b37b1f769793cae4c8874.gif[/img]

Even if you have played this map before, you will find it hard to recognise now. And on top of it all, a brand new quest. But be careful, for your choices will matter in this quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/4be2c1b693f2418446daa26d26a38cd43d947dc0.jpg[/img]


[h3]Bugs[/h3]

Lots of them were fixed, thanks to you guys reporting them. But many still need fixing. If you think you've found a bug, please report it to us via the Steam community hub or via our discord.
Also, those bushes that turn into oysters – that is not a bug...it's... errrr.... the heat? Magic? Yes, magical heat.

We hope that you are as excited as us, that you can finally jump in and get to try a bit of the magic of what is to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/779bfd7e44bfc563923b98f46af1370b285a63c1.jpg[/img]

[*] The beginning of the main quest and some side quests
[*] 13 out of the 100+ Porbles are there to be battled and captured by you

Things not ([b]yet[/b]) available

[list]
[*] The Fusion system (but you can already visit the fusion lab)
[*] Architect Mode
[*] PVP mode
[*] Translations in other languages. We are currently working on improving all the non-English fonts, so the dialogues are all in English. You can have some UI items in other languages but they will be far from optimized.

notes.title: How fabulous is your hair for dimensional travel?
notes.content:
Picture this. You are about to start an epic adventure that will change not only your fate but the fate of the world. What is the first thing you need to take care of? That's right! Make sure you look fabulous. 

That is the case in Portal Fantasy.  Before you face the world and even think about catching your first porble you will have the chance to decide on how you look to the world using our [b]Character Creator [/b] system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/cecafe97208b6dc419360e8522aea0c3936ada77.gif[/img]

From head to toe, you can choose your favourite style. 
[list]
[*]Want to have red hair with pigtails and a gorgeous pink dress? We gotcha!
[*] Spiky dark hair to match your treasure-hunter suit? Right on it!
[*] The shiniest golden suit so people don't notice your balding grey hair? Done!
[/list]
The possibilities are so immense that it will be hard to bump into another player in the world that looks like you.
But if you are truly a fashion guru your work is not done yet. Time to visit the twins over at the [b]Enchantera Shop[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/b3096c5d2363f1252165ddce7e065119999b6bf4.gif[/img]

There you will have an impressive array of hats, capes and necklaces to truly show the world that you are the most stylish hero this universe has ever seen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c2a7b52355fac1d6ff85925368929fd907289145.gif[/img]

With all of this you can create millions of combinations and create a unique look. Think how awesome your statue will look in the middle of the town square where people can admire your immense fashion style for generations. Well, that and how you saved them all...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/906885498411408dcc544a98f9769912baaa2e80.gif[/img]

notes.title: Why mod when you can create?
notes.content:
Did you ever look at a game level and think [i]"Well that is a nice map, but if I was the one making it I would do this instead"[/i]?

In that case, we have something cool to show you. 
Presenting the [b]Architect[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/6af76fc414b54da08729ae720de6235ebb83464f.gif[/img]

As an Architect you will be able to build your own levels for yourself, your friends, and other players to play. Although what we are about to show you is still a limited early version of it, we were way too excited to not reveal it already.
So keep in mind the following:
[list]
[*] Everything here is in development so it might change (and if it does it will be to improve it).
[*] Nothing has been sped up. It is all in real-time.
[*] This is real "gameplay" footage, not concept art or a scripted scene.
[/list]

If you decide to play as an Architect you will soon find out that building a world is not only fun but also fairly intuitive and easy. We are trying to make this into an experience that doesn't require any previous experience in game design and that you don't end up spending hours trying to get that stone corner to match the rest. 
In little more than 10 seconds you can build some stone cliffs with swamp lakes for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/322cf08cd4afaabc8068634fd7f4c25a730bbd9a.gif[/img]

Add some items like barrels and stones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/8b6cbb5b90b96ce7680e26e57a2c9248d331b85d.gif[/img]

And even create your ideal floor with our tilesets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/291a9db389e27d52d46b6581b14e5fcf3f9742fd.gif[/img]

And if you change your mind or want to make something different you can always move items, remove or flip them for example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/c57d3746b3812b8d42c35a95bc85fe97acd0abdc.gif[/img]

And this is just the beginning, we are working on so many options that we hope you will enjoy. From critters to NPCs, custom-made quests and so much more. We can't wait to see what you can create with it all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44382825/89cb910158b62054ab246a555f9567704f677b0b.png[/img]
